title: Freed Iranian Political Prisoners Get Their Lives Back, But Not Their Seized Belongings

title: Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements

title: As Deadline Looms, Ex-US Marine Desperately Seeks Brother At Afghan Refugee Camp In Qatar
content: A former US Marine has spent days trying to see his brother at a camp in Qatar holding Afghan refugees in limbo after plans to bring them to the United States were blocked by a presidential executive order. The camp is due to close on September 30, and the inmates don’t know what will happen next.
